reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: To start with, our family has flown with more than 8 different airlines in the span of 20 years, and we have never seen anything like this before. Over the course of 2 months, we flew with SkyUp airlines three times. The first two flights were to and from Hurghada. When we boarded the plane, we were surprised by the small legroom. Even as someone who is 1.55m tall, it was difficult for me to sit through the 5-hour-long flight. The plane appeared old and was really loud. Around 1.5 hours into the flight, I woke up because my head, hands, and legs were freezing. When my father asked for a blanket, they inquired if we were cold and informed us that there were no blankets on board. Other passengers were also complaining about the cold. They increased the temperature slightly, making it a bit warmer. No food or water was offered to us, even though free water on board was advertised. On the return flight, we were more prepared and wore our coats and two pairs of socks each. Again, there was no legroom, it was cold, impossible to fall asleep due to uncomfortable seats, and no food or water provided. The third flight was from Antalya. Initially, we were told we would fly with TailWind airlines, so we were disappointed to see a SkyUp airplane. This time it was the Shakhtar model. At first, the airplane looked nice and new, but we soon realized that the seats were even more uncomfortable than the ones on the flights to and from Hurghada. It was uncomfortable to sit without bending our necks or backs in awkward positions. Before and during takeoff, as well as the first half of the flight, it was so hot that people used the safety instructions as makeshift fans. It was impossible to fall asleep due to uncomfortable seats and lack of legroom. After 1.5 hours, it became so cold that we had to retrieve the jackets we had stowed away at the beginning of the flight. It seems that SkyUp can't regulate the temperature properly. Once again, there were no blankets on board. People were freezing, and at some point, 6 or 7 people were standing because the seats were too unbearable to sit in. After enduring 3.5 unbearable hours in uncomfortable seats and a cold airplane, we finally landed. When we literally hit the ground, the entire plane groaned as the landing gear hit the ground hard, and the captain braked abruptly. During these flights, the crew can speak English or Russian. However, they prefer speaking English, but their English is really difficult to understand. Out of 2 or 3 sentences, I could only make out a few words here and there. Upon landing, SkyUp thanked us for choosing their services. If it were up to us, we wouldn't use them again.

reviews.title: Easy ride
reviews.text: I had a vacation in Spain (Barcelona-Cambrils-Tenerife). KBP to BCN was done by Ukrainian International Airline. My first time - it was decent but legroom DOES NOT COMPLY WITH MY STANDARDS. I heard some NOT GOOD about them. So safe bet, I guess... Also - free 50cl of water 💧 BCN to TFN was done by Vueling. Again - no legroom for free (sorry, I don't think that's a good practice to buy a seat with some additional space - whatever that means because it differs from company to company - for 20-50 euro), even no free water. Jesus Celsius. From TFS to KBP I flew with Sky Up. I had my prejudices. No online check in and I had to check in in the airport. Alright 🤌 So I got to TFS and the check in was good. Only two lines but whatever, I had so much time. They took the baggage and give me a boarding pass. A decent start. Soooo the flight was delayed by 35-40 minutes. Boarding was nice and quick, though, no issues (UIA sacked at it - my boarding pass was screaming red during scanning but eventually I was boarded :) I sat on 0 euro seat and it was deliciously spacey. Jesus came to save from manspreading all 7h long. Except one guy who ducking danced on his seat and eventually made me asked him to keep it together and don't break my knee with his leaning procedure (see that meathead below in photos). I pre-ordered a skybox (meal with chicken with mushrooms, some rolls and salad, a cake and a bread) It was very good for lower that 500 uah (less than 20 usd?) Crew was good. This was 10x times better that Ryanair that I had from Sweden to Ukraine. It was kinda... Lufthansaining dream with less money paid and a direct flight :) I guess sometimes SkyUp ISN'T GOOD but this is a lowcost. It's a risky venture. Also, when people thinks that SkyUp is a fraud because that cannot differentiate an itineranary receipt from a boarding pass - folks, KEEP YOUR SHOT TOGETHER. Open your eyes. Try to think. All the best.

reviews.text: The flight was delayed 17 hours! The planned flight was at 21:05, we waited till 00:00 and nobody told us nothing. After a while they said there is a technical issue and the flight will be at 05:00 by another plane. We continued to wait at the small airport without comfort. They served us a small burger, fries and water. Around 04:00 they announced that the flight will be at 10:00 by the same plane (they said boing company gave approval for the flight). They offered us hotel but many of us preferred not to go because there would be just a few hours for rest. After around 10:00 they said flight will be at 11:05, finally they opened the gate at 11:00. Boarding completed but we were still waiting. Then they sent us back to the airport, the explanation was about technical issues again. Finally around 14:00 we were again on board. This time they said there is one person more at the plane and started to count flyers. After 35 minutes they realized that everything is normal and we could fly. I had flied more than 300 times in my life and that was the worst flying experience for me. I will stay away from this company forever.
